events.title: Open House New York (OHNY) Drop-In Tours at Greenway Botanical Garden
events.description: October 16 | 5:42 am Brooklyn Greenway Initiative , Nelson Byrd Woltz Landscape Architects , and Understory Landscape Architecture invite you to stroll through our native plant meadow and pollinator habitat — with a chance to hear from one of the landscape architects who created it ten years ago. Stroll through a native plant meadow and pollinator habitat, with a chance to hear from the landscape architect, or take a self-guided tour to learn about the history and ecology of the site. Tours, led by Jeffrey Longhenry , principal of Understory Landscape Architecture and lead landscape designer of the Greenway Botanical Garden with Nelson Byrd Woltz Landscape Architects, will offer first-come, first-served tours starting at 12PM and 1PM lasting approximately 50-minutes each. *** Please note this is a three day event from Noon – 6pm each day.
